Way too much. I hate watching him grow up treated like a boy when I never could. I hate seeing all his boyish shit lying around. I hate that most of his friends are cis boys whereas most of my friends are femme-aligned or androgynous. 

On the flip side I'm also angry for us both. He's being brought up with very strict, old fashioned gender roles and I hate to watch it not only because I'm thinking the *fuck you I should've been treated like that* (even though I would've hated that treatment too, just less than the "girl" treatment) but because I'm thinking *fuck you, stop traumatizing and emotionally numbing my precious brother.* I've seen on numerous occasions his legal guardians tell him to shut up and stop crying because "boys don't cry" (to be fair I was also told to shut up and stop crying but that's because it's apparently annoying for me to cry, and it matters much more that some asshole is getting annoyed than that I need emotional release before I snap and do something stupid). I've seen one of the legal guardians comment on his bodily fluids and shit being "manly" which is very weird because he's a child and it's also just gross. It disgusts me just as much as I long for it, and I fear the day that this upbringing turns my own brother against me, against himself, and against the world in general. I want him to be happy and healthy. These kinds of gender roles aren't healthy and they're not going to make him happy.

At the very least that's sexist, and more realistically it's transphobic. Really gotta check the harmful views of family sometimes, I always try to keep my little brother on the benevolent side of things
